title: From the Zoo to the BULLPEN: Sample-Efficient LLM Profiling via Multi-Channel Model Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.41375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Choosing among the hundreds of thousands of available large language models (LLMs) requires a thorough understanding of each candidate model's properties. In practice, each property is measured by its own benchmark suite, so profiling a model on many properties means paying for many separate evaluations. To address this, model embeddings compress each model into a fixed-length vector from which many properties can be predicted. Existing methods, such as EmbedLLM, build these vectors from correctness patterns and question features, and often need large probe batteries to do so. translated_title: 从模型动物园到BULLPEN：基于多通道模型嵌入的样本高效大语言模型画像
translated_abstract: 在数十万个可用的大语言模型（LLM）中进行选择，需要对每个候选模型的属性有透彻的了解。在实践中，每个属性都由其专属的基准测试套件来衡量，因此对一个模型的多个属性进行画像意味着需要支付多次独立评估的成本。为了解决这一问题，模型嵌入将每个模型压缩成一个固定长度的向量，从中可以预测多个属性。现有方法（如EmbedLLM）基于正确性模式和问题特征来构建这些向量，但通常需要大量的探测题集才能实现。然而，在选择模型时十分重要的许多行为特征，例如模型的回答冗长度、安全性和风格，更多地体现在其如何回答问题，而非回答是否正确上。我们提出了BULLPEN（通过画像编码实现大语言模型的行为理解），这是一个在三个方面对EmbedLLM进行扩展的框架。首先，BULLPEN将下游任务组织……
tldr: 提出BULLPEN框架，通过融合回答行为（如冗长度、安全性与风格）的多通道模型嵌入，以更少的探测样本高效预测大语言模型的多种属性，显著降低评估成本。
en_tdlr: BULLPEN is a sample-efficient LLM profiling framework that extends EmbedLLM using multi-channel model embeddings, capturing behavioral traits such as verbosity, safety, and style to predict many model properties with fewer probe questions.
